talkingPoints.text: soft and smooth with a clear blur effect

benefits.text: Chaltteok Blush is a bouncy powder blush with a lightweight texture that is easy to blend and can be layered to adjust intensity. It helps create a natural flushed-cheek effect, making the face look fresher while keeping a soft, smooth finish that doesn't feel heavy on the skin.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Jelly–powder hybrid; soft, bouncy powder with mochi-like elasticity.

finish.text: Smooth matte, soft blur effect; can be blended sheer or layered for more color.

claimDisclaimers.text: Blur/filling is a visual makeup effect. Actual color depends on skin tone, lighting and amount used. Testing information is per the brand's published documentation; do not infer absolute safety for everyone. The original test records have not been verified.

shadeDescription.text: Clear milky white, used as a base color or for a soft, bright-cheek effect

howToUse.text: Use a brush or puff to pick up an appropriate amount and pat lightly onto the cheeks. Can be used alone for a natural bright-cheek effect or layered with other shades to add clarity.

positioning.text: Bouncy powder blush with a smooth blur effect; milky white for brightening and color mixing.

sellingPoints.text:
1. Jelly–bouncy powder texture, easy to blend.
2. Milky white helps with mixing pastel colors.
3. Built-in silicone puff under the powder compartment.
